contract.intended_consumer: Brian and his coding agents activating outcome admission in Project Graph-authorized normal projects
contract.outcome: Canonical Project Graph project IDs are representable without weakening outcome or lineage slugs, licensing the exact Qualitative Coding pilot.

canonical_journey.starting_state: The accepted outcome contract rejects the authoritative active Project Graph ID qualitative_coding because project identity reuses an unrelated hyphen-only slug grammar.
canonical_journey.input: The exact qualitative_coding record from a pinned reviewed Project Graph revision and one otherwise-valid maintenance outcome contract.
canonical_journey.action: Separate project-ID validation from outcome and lineage slug validation, then resolve the real QC identity through portfolio allocation controls.
canonical_journey.observable_result: qualitative_coding validates and resolves exactly; existing hyphenated identities remain compatible; malformed IDs and weakened outcome/lineage slugs still fail.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: The implementation invents an alias, accepts unsafe identifiers, weakens outcome/lineage grammar, or passes only a contract unit test without portfolio resolution.
